description: This Java class 'MockZigbeeCore' simulates a Zigbee network core for testing purposes. It manages devices, network configuration, and events related to Zigbee network operations.

classes.name: MockZigbeeCore
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee network core for testing and simulation purposes, managing devices, network state, and events.

methods.name: networkChange
methods.description: Changes the Zigbee network configuration such as channel, PAN ID, and network key.

methods.name: getNetworkStatus
methods.description: Returns a table representing the current network status and configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the mock Zigbee core, initializing device lists and starting request receiver.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists all devices (paired and unpaired) in a table format.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the mock Zigbee core and clears device lists and state.

methods.name: sendStartupIfNecessary
methods.description: Sends a startup event if it hasn't been sent already.

methods.name: sendNetworkHealthProblem
methods.description: Sends a network health problem event.

methods.name: sendPanIdAttack
methods.description: Sends a PAN ID attack event.

methods.name: sendNetworkHealthProblemRestored
methods.description: Sends an event indicating network health has been restored.

methods.name: getDevicesByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of devices filtered by their class type.

methods.name: getDeviceByNameAndType
methods.description: Retrieves a device by name and type.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the network, either unpaired or paired depending on network join timing.

methods.name: addPairedDevice
methods.description: Adds and marks a device as paired.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from paired devices and adds it to unpaired.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if a device is paired.

methods.name: enableJoin
methods.description: Enables device joining for a specified duration.

methods.name: isNetworkOpenForJoin
methods.description: Checks if the network is currently open for device joining.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its EUI64.

methods.name: getAllDevices
methods.description: Returns all devices in the network.

methods.name: getPairedDevices
methods.description: Returns all paired devices.

methods.name: getUnpairedDevices
methods.description: Returns all unpaired devices.

methods.name: refreshOtaFiles
methods.description: Triggers OTA files refresh event.
